core_obligations: Translate the map by adjunction (proof lines 1767-1786): by adjointness of the derived pushforward and pullback, a map from the residue field shifted by one into the pushforward of the structure sheaf is the same as a map from the derived pullback of the residue field shifted by one into the structure sheaf; the cohomology sheaves of that pullback vanish above degree one, equal the structure sheaf of the closed fibre in degree one, and are some module over it in degrees at most zero.

Identify the map with an extension (proof lines 1778-1790): since maps out of the degree zero cohomology sheaf into the structure sheaf vanish because the structure sheaf is torsion free, the spectral sequence for Ext collapses to show that the maps in the derived category are exactly the first Ext group out of the structure sheaf of the closed fibre, so the map is given by an extension of the structure sheaf by that sheaf.

Kill the extension (proof lines 1790-1804): the pullback of the extension along the surjection onto the structure sheaf of the closed fibre is zero, so the constant section lifts to a global section of the middle term; multiplying that section by the ideal sheaf of the closed fibre gives a map from the ideal into the structure sheaf, and pushing it forward yields a map from the maximal ideal into the base, which is multiplication by an element because the base is a Noetherian normal local domain; replacing the section by its difference with that element makes it annihilated by the ideal, so the extension is trivial.
proof_roadmap: Use adjunction to replace the map by a map from the derived pullback of the residue field into the structure sheaf.
Use the cohomology sheaves of that pullback and the Ext spectral sequence to identify the map with an extension class.
Use the vanishing of the pullback of the class to lift a section and show the extension splits via the normality of the base.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the vanishing situation with the source normal and the base Nagata, the group of maps from the residue field shifted by one into the derived pushforward of the structure sheaf is zero (statement lines 1756-1766). The proof (proof lines 1767-1804) applies adjunction, computes the cohomology sheaves of the derived pullback of the residue field, applies the Ext spectral sequence to turn the map into an extension of the structure sheaf by the structure sheaf of the closed fibre, and then splits that extension by lifting a section and using that the base is a Noetherian normal local domain. H3: several computed steps with an explicit lifting argument, written out in full.
